acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text: By accessing and using the Catechis platform, you agree to these Terms of Use.

service.title: 2. Service Description
service.text: Catechis is a SaaS platform for Catholic catechesis management: classes, attendance, content, sacraments, and pastoral communication.

obligations.title: 3. User Obligations
items: Provide true and up-to-date information
Keep your credentials confidential
Do not share your account with third parties
Use the platform only for catechesis and pastoral purposes
Respect LGPD rules when handling catechumen data

liability.title: 4. Limitation of Liability
liability.text: Catechis is not responsible for content published by users, pastoral decisions based on platform data, or temporary unavailability.

jurisdiction.title: 5. Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.text: The courts of São Paulo, Brazil, are elected to resolve any disputes arising from these Terms of Use.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.text: Catechis is committed to protecting the personal data of its users and of catechumens, in accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018). This policy explains which data we process, why, who we share it with, how long we keep it and how you exercise your rights.

controller.title: 2. Who is responsible for the data
controller.text: When a parish, diocese or catechist uses the platform to organize catechesis, that institution (or the catechist, on the personal plan) is the controller of the data about catechumens and families: it decides who is registered and why. Catechis acts as the processor, handling that data only to provide the contracted service and according to the controller's instructions. For your own account data (sign-up, login, subscription), Catechis is the controller.

collected.title: 3. Data we collect
collected.intro: We only collect the data needed to provide the service:
items: Name, email, phone and optional photo of users (catechists, coordinators, guardians)
Name, date of birth, optional photo and family link of catechumens
Attendance records, absence notes and pastoral notes from meetings
Sacramental documents uploaded by families (for example, baptism certificates)
Image-use and communication consents
Technical access data (IP address, browser, date and time) for security and fraud prevention
Subscription payment data, processed directly by Stripe — we never store your card number

purpose.title: 4. Why we process data
items: Manage catechesis (classes, meetings, attendance, sacraments and documents)
Support pastoral communication between coordinators, catechists and families
Produce pastoral reports for the parish, without public exposure of individual data
Bill and manage the subscription
Keep accounts secure, provide support and meet legal obligations
purpose.outro: We do not sell personal data and we do not use catechumens' data for advertising.

legal_basis.title: 5. Legal bases
legal_basis.text: We process data to perform the contract with whoever subscribes to the service (art. 7, V), to comply with legal obligations (art. 7, II), on legitimate interest for security and service improvement (art. 7, IX), and on consent where required — for example, for image use, marketing cookies and children's data (art. 7, I and art. 14).

minors.title: 6. Children's and teenagers' data (LGPD art. 14)
minors.intro: Most catechumens are minors, so their data is processed in the best interest of the child and adolescent:
items: Data about children (up to 12 years old) is only processed with specific, prominent consent from at least one parent or legal guardian, recorded on the platform by the parish or catechist
We collect the minimum needed for catechesis; no data is required as a condition for taking part in games, apps or activities beyond what is strictly necessary
Families can see in the family portal which data about the catechumen is registered and which consents were given
Photos of catechumens are only used with the guardian's image consent
Access is restricted to the class's catechists and coordinators; minors' data is never shared with third parties for commercial purposes
Parents and guardians can ask for correction or deletion at any time, through the parish or the data protection contact below

sharing.title: 7. Sharing with service providers
sharing.intro: We only share data with providers that help us run the service, under contract and bound by confidentiality:
items: Cloud hosting, database and file storage
Stripe, to process subscription payments
Transactional email providers (confirmations, invitations and notices)
Error monitoring, to fix technical failures
Analytics and marketing tools (Google and Meta) only if you accept the corresponding cookies
sharing.outro: Some of these providers may store data outside Brazil. In those cases we require adequate safeguards, as set out in LGPD art. 33.

retention.title: 8. How long we keep data
retention.text: We keep data while the account or institution uses the platform. When an account is closed, its data is deleted or anonymized, except what we must keep by law (for example, tax records for the subscription). The parish can export its data before closing.

security.title: 9. Security
security.text: We use encrypted connections (HTTPS), role-based access (coordinator, catechist, family), optional two-factor authentication and audit logs. If a relevant security incident occurs, we will notify those affected and the ANPD as required by law.

cookies.title: 10. Cookies
cookies.text: We use essential cookies for login and for the app to work. Analytics and marketing cookies are only enabled with your consent in the cookie notice, and you can change that choice at any time.

rights.title: 11. Your rights (LGPD)
items: Confirm whether we process your data and access it
Correct incomplete or outdated data
Export your data (portability) — available under Settings in the app
Ask for deletion or anonymization of unnecessary data
Withdraw consent and learn who we share data with
rights.outro: If the request involves catechumens registered by a parish, we will forward it to that parish and help them respond.

dpo.title: 12. Data protection officer (DPO)
dpo.text: Catechis's data protection officer is the official channel for questions, data subject requests and communications from the ANPD.
dpo.response: We reply within 15 days. You can also reach us at contato@catechis.app or through the Contact page.
